Name: (CP) Alternative Seasonal Portrait for Lance
Author: poohnhi
Description:
[size=5][b]How to install:[/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]This mod is a Content Patcher mod, so all you have to do is extract the files to your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=4]If you prefer Lesh's art style for the portraits, you can [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15763]download their mod[/url] and replace all the files in this mod Portraits folder with their portrait files.[/size]
[*][size=4]The 1.6 version will be updated if necessary after testing on SVE for SDV 1.6.[/size]
[*][size=4]You can still use this mod for SDV 1.5.6 and below as optional files.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Credits[/b]:
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Lesh: Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15763]Lesh's Lance's sprite and portrait[/url] with different hair and in vanilla (Poltergeister) style! The portraits and sprites from this mod are modified from Lesh's portrait and sprites mod.[/size]
[*][size=4]Poltergeister: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] for Lance's original seasonal outfit portraits and sprites! The seasonal outfits from this mod are modified from Poltergeister's seasonal outfits mod.[/size]
[*][size=4]Qingsha: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13232]Qingsha's Lance's HD portrait[/url] for the original idea of different hairstyle and eye scar![/size]
[*][size=4]FlashShifter and the SVE team: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ - the expansion that added Lance as an NPC! Without this mod, Lance wouldn't show up.[/size]
[/list]


[size=5][b]Bug report:[/b]
[/size]
[size=4][url=https://smapi.io/log]Click here to see instruction about uploading a SMAPI log.[/url][/size][size=4]﻿ Share your log link in the comment or bug report section and I'll help troubleshoot ASAP.
[/size]


[b][size=5]Question and suggestion:
[/size][/b]
[size=4]Feel free to leave a comment if you have any question or suggestion![/size]

Downloads.Description:
Please install this one for Stardew Valley 1.5.6 or lower.

@LEGACY

Manifest.Name: (CP) Alternative Seasonal Portrait for Lance
Manifest.Description: Gives Lance an alternative seasonal portrait set with a scar and a different hairstyle based on Qingsha's Lance portraits. Sprites and portraits are modified and ported to Content Patcher with Lesh's permission. Original sprites and seasonal outfits are from Poltergeister. See README.md for full credits.
Manifest.Author: Pooh
